column1: # avoid.waivers.tsv — the accepted exceptions of scripts/avoid.sh (spec §2.7, design §9.3,
# PLAN.md §5.4-§5.5). Author-written; under scripts/, so guard rule 2g keeps it out of every
# learner and contractor edit. Every exception to the disjointness gate is one row here.
# Columns (tab-separated): id, state, key, source, direction, reason, cost.
#   id         W<n> / X<n>: a waiver of design §9.3 (X = cross-course); N<n>: a name-only
#              waiver (a name collision with no shared genre, cost "none").
#   state      adopted | provisional (the orchestrator adopted it pending a probe).
#   key        `-`: a GENRE row, a shared genre a name scan cannot see; it is listed, never
#              claimed as caught, and its item homes in armed modules must exist.
#              Otherwise a normalized key: a NAME row, waiving the hits with that key whose
#              owner:<owner>:<tag>, corpus:<half>) in that direction. A name row that waives
#              no hit is an error (stale, like a stale pin) whenever its target track has
#   source     a genre row's homes: "<Q home> → <R home>".
#   direction  Q→R (Q is the home, R repeats it), R→Q, Lean→R or Lean→Q.
#   reason     the genre, or why the name stands.
#   cost       the insight pre-empted for a learner who does the home first.
# W15-W18 adopted by the orchestrator (DV5a; PLAN.md §5.4, QPLAN §19.7 F23). W19 (provisional) was dropped in DV5c:
# Q14.H5v and Q17.H2v move no permission out of a tracked map (DELTAS Δ177, Δ211, Δ217).
